# cpanel_mysql_remote_host (Resource)

Authorizes one remote host to connect to the cPanel account's MySQL or MariaDB databases.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cpanel_mysql_remote_host" "reporting" {
  host = "198.51.100.20"
  note = "Reporting application"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) The IPv4 address, IPv4 CIDR prefix, IPv4 percent-wildcard pattern, or hostname to authorize.

### Optional

- `note` (String) An optional note stored by cPanel for the remote host. Changing it replaces the authorization because cPanel 134 does not reliably update an existing note.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cpanel_mysql_remote_host.reporting 198.51.100.20
```
